land_pattern.package: PowerDI123 - from the datasheet's own 'Suggested Pad Layout' drawing and table (page 4).
land_pattern.notes: SUGGESTED PAD LAYOUT (page 4, mm): G = 0.65 (gap between the two pads), X = 1.05 (small/ANODE pad width), X1 = 2.40 (large/CATHODE pad width), X2 = 4.10 (overall span), Y = 1.50 and Y1 = 1.50 (both pad heights). Self-consistent: X + G + X1 = 1.05 + 0.65 + 2.40 = 4.10 = X2. DERIVED pad-centre spacing = X/2 + G + X1/2 = 0.525 + 0.65 + 1.20 = 2.375 mm -> that is the pitch_mm above (the nearest-neighbour distance fp_verify measures). pad_size_mm is deliberately OMITTED because the two pads are DIFFERENT sizes (cathode 2.40 x 1.50, anode 1.05 x 1.50); fp_verify's modal-size check would tie-break arbitrarily and report a meaningless result. CROSS-CHECK (not a datasheet statement): KiCad 10.0 Diode_SMD:D_PowerDI-123 has pad 1 at x = -0.85 sized 2.4 x 1.5 and pad 2 at x = +1.525 sized 1.05 x 1.5 - centre spacing 2.375 mm, pad sizes identical to this table, and its pad 1 is the 2.4 mm CATHODE pad. That library footprint matches this datasheet exactly. PACKAGE OUTLINE (page 4 table, min/max/typ mm): A 0.93/1.00/0.98 (height), A3 0.15/0.25/0.20, b 0.85/1.25/1.00, b2 1.025/1.125/1.10, D 1.63/1.93/1.78 (body width), E 3.50/3.90/3.70 (overall length terminal-to-terminal), E1 2.60/3.00/2.80 (body length), L 0.40/0.50/0.45 (2x anode lead), L1 1.25/1.40/1.35 (cathode tab), L3 0.125/0.275/0.20. Two package options (A and B) are drawn; they differ only in the terminal edge profile (option B has notched terminal ends) and share the same dimension table.
